description_blocks.text: The NFC Tag with Adhesive is a durable and versatile solution for integrating NFC functionality into a wide range of projects. Featuring a robust plastic or composite material, this tag is designed to withstand various environmental conditions while offering the convenience of an adhesive backing for easy attachment. Its sturdy construction makes it ideal for applications requiring long-term durability, such as embedding in industrial equipment, smart signage, or 3D-printed objects. With its ability to store and transfer data securely, the NFC Tag with Adhesive is a reliable choice for enhancing interactivity and functionality in your designs.
Wide Compatibility: Fully compatible with most NFC-enabled devices, including smartphones, tablets, and NFC readers.
Easy to Use: Durable adhesive backing ensures strong and secure attachment to various surfaces, including 3D-printed objects, metal, plastic, or wood.
Durable and Reliable: Built with robust PVC material, designed for long-term use, supporting up to 100,000 read/write cycles and 10 years of data retention.
Advanced Security: Features anti-collision technology and unique serial numbers for stable and secure data transmission, ideal for sensitive or critical applications.
Versatile Applications: Excellent for embedding in 3D-printed objects, industrial equipment, smart home automation, access control systems, and more.
Prepare Your Device Ensure your device (smartphone, NFC reader, etc.) supports NFC functionality.
Write Data Download an NFC programming app like "NFC Tools."
Open the app, select the “Write” option, and input the desired data (e.g., URL, text, or commands).
Bring the NFC tag close to the device’s NFC area to complete the writing process.
Test Your Tag Test the tag by bringing it near your device to confirm successful data writing.
Application Attach or embed the NFC tag to your desired object or location (e.g., 3D printed models, smart devices).
Can I rewrite data on the NFC Tag with Adhesive? Yes, the NTAG215 chip supports multiple rewrites up to 100,000 cycles.

Is the NFC Tag with Adhesive waterproof? The NFC Tag with Adhesive is made from PVC material with an adhesive backing, providing basic water resistance. It can withstand light splashes or brief water exposure, but prolonged submersion in water is not recommended.
Is it compatible with both Android and iOS devices? Yes, it is compatible with most Android and iOS devices with NFC functionality.

description_html:
Introduction

The NFC Tag with Adhesive is a durable and versatile solution for integrating NFC functionality into a wide range of projects. Featuring a robust plastic or composite material, this tag is designed to withstand various environmental conditions while offering the convenience of an adhesive backing for easy attachment. Its sturdy construction makes it ideal for applications requiring long-term durability, such as embedding in industrial equipment, smart signage, or 3D-printed objects. With its ability to store and transfer data securely, the NFC Tag with Adhesive is a reliable choice for enhancing interactivity and functionality in your designs.

Models Creators Model Links
Valentine's Day Heart Box
 @SouthLab Valentine's Day Heart Box

Product Feature

 

  • Wide Compatibility: Fully compatible with most NFC-enabled devices, including smartphones, tablets, and NFC readers.
  • Easy to Use: Durable adhesive backing ensures strong and secure attachment to various surfaces, including 3D-printed objects, metal, plastic, or wood.
  • Durable and Reliable: Built with robust PVC material, designed for long-term use, supporting up to 100,000 read/write cycles and 10 years of data retention.
  • Advanced Security: Features anti-collision technology and unique serial numbers for stable and secure data transmission, ideal for sensitive or critical applications.
  • Versatile Applications: Excellent for embedding in 3D-printed objects, industrial equipment, smart home automation, access control systems, and more.

Usage Instructions

  1. Prepare Your Device
    Ensure your device (smartphone, NFC reader, etc.) supports NFC functionality.

  2.  Write Data
    Download an NFC programming app like "NFC Tools."

  3. Open the app, select the “Write” option, and input the desired data (e.g., URL, text, or commands).
  4. Bring the NFC tag close to the device’s NFC area to complete the writing process.
  5.  Test Your Tag
    Test the tag by bringing it near your device to confirm successful data writing.
  6.  Application
    Attach or embed the NFC tag to your desired object or location (e.g., 3D printed models, smart devices).

 

Basic Information

Chip Type NTAG215
Operating Temperature -25°C to 55°C
Read Range 0-5CM
Data Retention 10 years
Read Durability 100,000 cycles
Material PVC with Adhesive Backing
Frequency 13.56MHZ
Quantity 20 PCS

Frequently Asked Questions

 

  1. Can I rewrite data on the NFC Tag with Adhesive?
    Yes, the NTAG215 chip supports multiple rewrites up to 100,000 cycles.

  2.  Is the NFC Tag with Adhesive waterproof?
    The NFC Tag with Adhesive is made from PVC material with an adhesive backing, providing basic water resistance. It can withstand light splashes or brief water exposure, but prolonged submersion in water is not recommended.

  3. Is it compatible with both Android and iOS devices?
    Yes, it is compatible with most Android and iOS devices with NFC functionality.
